# Errors

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Names error types from the kernel and the userspace IPC contracts.

```c
#include <zuzu/err.h>
```

## Types

| Type | Definition | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="err"></a>`Err` | `int32_t` | Generic error code type. Non-positive error code. Never positive Check zuzu/err.h for error codes. |

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="zuzu_ok"></a>`ZUZU_OK` | `0` | No error has occurred, the operation was successful. |

## Enumerations

### `KilledReason` { #killedreason }

Task kill reason.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KILLED_BY_PARENT` | `0` | Parent destroyed the task object. |
| `KILLED_FAULT_DATA` | `1` | The task caused a data abort. |
| `KILLED_FAULT_PREFETCH` | `2` | The task caused a prefetch abort. |
| `KILLED_FAULT_UNDEF` | `3` | The task executed an undefined instruction. |
| `KILLED_FAULT_ALIGN` | `4` | The task accessed unaligned memory. |
| `KILLED_OOM` | `5` | The task was victim to an OOM service. |

## Functions

### `StrToError` { #strtoerror }

```c
const char * StrToError(Err errcode);
```

Converts an error code into a short explanatory string, or ERR -XXX if the error is unknown.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `errcode` | in | Numeric error code. |

**Returns:** Explanatory string.
